_comment: Manual overrides applied by scripts/build_draft.py on top of ESPN's projections, for news newer than ESPN's numbers. Keyed by full name. projGp replaces ESPN's projected games; minScale multiplies every counting stat (role change); note is shown on the player's card. Re-run the export after editing.

Stephen Curry.note: Right ankle sprain at open practice Oct 18 (Kerr: 'fine', not serious; opener Oct 21 TBD). Docked from ESPN's 66 to 62 games: ~2 for the ankle, ~2 for re-aggravation risk at 38 after last season's 27-game knee absence.

Paul George.note: Age 36, 37 games last season, traded PHI to BOS. ESPN's 55 games and 33.2 minutes (up from 30.6) read optimistic: cut to 44 games and production scaled 0.82 for age decline, a smaller role on a new team, and load management.

Kyrie Irving.note: Torn left ACL March 2025; hasn't played in 19 months, age 34. Says he has no restrictions, but cut ESPN's 59 games to 46 and production scaled 0.86 for ramp-up, minutes management and re-injury risk.
